diff --git a/tests/test_filter_by_status.py b/tests/test_filter_by_status.py
index 1197689..d7d0367 100644
--- a/tests/test_filter_by_status.py
+++ b/tests/test_filter_by_status.py
@@ -15,3 +15,82 @@ def test_status_filter_is_case_insensitive_and_does_not_mutate_tasks():
 
 def test_status_filter_returns_empty_list_when_no_task_matches():
     assert filter_by_status([{"status": "open"}], "blocked") == []
+
+
+def test_status_filter_is_case_insensitive_in_both_query_and_data():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": "open"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "OPEN"},
+        {"id": 3, "status": "Open"},
+        {"id": 4, "status": "done"},
+    ]
+
+    for query in ("open", "OPEN", "Open", "oPeN"):
+        assert [task["id"] for task in filter_by_status(tasks, query)] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+
+def test_status_filter_with_none_returns_all_tasks_in_input_order():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": "open"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "done"},
+        {"id": 3},
+    ]
+
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks) == tasks
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, None) == tasks
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks) is not tasks
+
+
+def test_status_filter_on_empty_input_returns_empty_list():
+    assert filter_by_status([], "open") == []
+    assert filter_by_status([]) == []
+
+
+def test_status_filter_does_not_mutate_tasks_or_result_elements():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": "open", "title": "Write docs"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "done", "title": "Fix API"},
+    ]
+    original = [dict(task) for task in tasks]
+
+    result = filter_by_status(tasks, "open")
+
+    assert tasks == original
+    assert [task["id"] for task in result] == [1]
+    assert result[0] is tasks[0]
+    assert result == [{"id": 1, "status": "open", "title": "Write docs"}]
+
+
+def test_status_filter_ignores_tasks_without_a_status_key():
+    tasks = [{"id": 1}, {"id": 2, "status": "open"}]
+
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "open") == [{"id": 2, "status": "open"}]
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "done") == []
+
+
+def test_status_filter_accepts_any_iterable_and_preserves_input_order():
+    tasks = (
+        {"id": 1, "status": "OPEN"},
+        {"id": 2, "status": "done"},
+        {"id": 3, "status": "open"},
+    )
+
+    assert [task["id"] for task in filter_by_status(tasks, "Open")] == [1, 3]
+    assert [task["id"] for task in filter_by_status(iter(tasks), "Open")] == [1, 3]
+
+
+def test_status_filter_does_not_match_tasks_without_a_usable_status():
+    tasks = [
+        {"id": 1, "status": ""},
+        {"id": 2, "status": None},
+        {"id": 3},
+        {"id": 4, "status": 42},
+        {"id": 5, "status": "open"},
+    ]
+    original = [dict(task) for task in tasks]
+
+    assert [task["id"] for task in filter_by_status(tasks, "open")] == [5]
+    assert [task["id"] for task in filter_by_status(tasks, "")] == [1]
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "None") == []
+    assert filter_by_status(tasks, "42") == []
+    assert tasks == original
